title: Get approval for an advertising sign
what: Get the council's approval before putting up a sign that can be seen from a road or public place, unless the planning scheme regulates it or it is a permitted type.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.quote: A person must not undertake the prescribed activity without a current approval granted by the local government.

sources.title: Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2011
sources.locator: sch 2 pt 2, definition of installation of advertising devices
sources.quote: installation of advertising devices means the installation, erection or display of an advertisement or sign that is visible from a road or other public place.

sources.title: Subordinate Local Law No. 1 (Administration) 2024
sources.quote: an advertising device that is regulated by the local government’s planning scheme; or

confidence_note: Signs regulated by the planning scheme, and permitted signs such as small A-frame signs, need no approval (sch 10 s 2).

assessment.summary: Business signs need the council's approval unless they are an exempt type.
